title: Shuffle Lines
h1: Shuffle Lines of Text Online — Randomize Order Free
seoTitle: Shuffle Lines — Randomize Text Lines Free Online
description: Randomize the order of every line in a block of text. Ideal for mixing quiz questions, randomizing lists or creating varied test data. Runs completely in your browser.
intro: Paste a list and shuffle its lines into a new random order in one click. Useful for games, sampling or breaking predictable sequences without any server involvement.
blurb: Randomize the order of lines in any text block — free, private, instant.
howItWorks: Paste text with one item or sentence per line.
Press Shuffle to rearrange the lines into a new random order.
Copy the result. Empty lines are preserved in the mix.
The shuffle uses a standard Fisher-Yates algorithm and stays local.
examples: Randomize a list of student names for a fair drawing.
Mix the order of flash-card questions before a study session.
Create varied sample data from a fixed set of lines.

faq.a: Yes. Empty lines stay in the list and are shuffled along with the others.
It uses JavaScript’s Math.random() with a Fisher-Yates shuffle, which is suitable for everyday non-cryptographic use.
The original text remains in the input box, so you can shuffle again or clear and start over at any time.
